ApplePay.description: Displays apple pay for the Payment Services drop-in.

CreditCard.description: Renders the credit or debit card form (and optional “save this card” for signed-in shoppers). See `CardType` in `@adobe-commerce/payment-services-sdk/payment`.

StoredCards.description: Lists vaulted (saved) cards and an optional “pay with a new card” row for checkout.
